description: Kernel-level tracing and performance analysis using bpftrace scripts (TCP congestion window, socket queueing, network burst analysis).

subtools.name: tcp-window
subtools.description: Captures TCP congestion control and flow control state per connection (snd-cwnd, ssthresh, snd-wnd, srtt, rcv-wnd) via the tcp:tcp_probe tracepoint.

subtools.name: tx-burst
subtools.description: Traces individual packet enqueue events with nanosecond timestamps and packet lengths on a specified network interface via the net:net_dev_queue tracepoint to detect micro-burst transmission patterns.
